prompt: I generated a backend with BackendGenerator but I need to add custom validation logic to the API. If I edit main_api.py directly, will my changes survive the next generation? What's the right way to add custom endpoints?

assertions.text: Clearly states that generated files are overwritten on regeneration
Recommends creating separate extension/wrapper files that import from generated code
Shows a concrete code example of the extension pattern (importing from main_api or generated app)
Does NOT recommend editing main_api.py directly as the primary approach
